chunks.title: Hyderabadi_green_fried_chicken
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to show you Hyderabadi Green Chicken Fry. If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. First of all, we have taken half kg chicken. We have cut it into small pieces. For this, we will make a special masala. We are making green chicken. We have taken coriander leaves, mint leaves, curry leaves, green chilies, cashew nuts, garlic cloves, ginger pieces. We will grind all these in curd. We will grind 2-3 tsp curd. We have ground the curd. We will mix the green masala in it. We will add half tsp turmeric and lemon juice. I will add half tsp black pepper powder. According to taste, I will add salt. I will add little oil. Now we will mix all these spices with chicken. We will mix it for half an hour and then we will fry it. I will show you the process later. We will mix it well and fry it for half an hour. It is better to keep it for a long time. But we will keep it for half an hour. Now we will fry the chicken after half an hour. Now we have put the pan on the stove. We will add 2-3 tsp ghee. It gives a good flavor. You can make it in oil but traditionally it is made in ghee. We will let it heat. Now we will add the chicken. We will fry it for 2-3 minutes. We will keep the flame high. We will fry it for 2-3 minutes. And then we will lower the flame. Now we will add curry leaves. 6-7 curry leaves gives a good taste. We will mix it well. Now we will cover it for 2 minutes. We will check it in between. We will check it after 2 minutes. We will remove the lid after 2 minutes. And we will check it. We will mix it well and dry it well. We will mix it well and dry it well. We will keep the flame high. We will mix it well and dry it well. We will add coriander leaves. We will mix it well. We will mix it well and dry it well. We will remove the lid. The chicken is fried. We have added a special tempering on top. We will add ghee. We will add chopped onion. We will mix it well. We will mix it well. We will add curry leaves and green chilies. We will let it get a little brown. Now we will add this tempering on top. Hyderabadi Green Fried Chicken is ready. If you liked the recipe, please like and subscribe to the channel. Thanks for watching.
